text_block_list.text:
The true identity of the admired board gamer
'dominare' was none
other than Rulership—
the problem child who even gives Air Groove
a headache!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
choice_data_list: Thanks for always playing online g...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It is I, 'dominare'-san,
the one you look up to...
Wait,
that was you? A Trainer here? ...For real?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, my bad. You admired me so much,
and here
I went and shattered your dreams. Ah haha...
...............I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You will do no such thing!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Gah, no! Let me go home!
Acting all cool this whole time only for
this to happen makes me look like an idiot!
This is the worst!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stop spouting nonsense and stand up
straight!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day
you will fulfill your duties as a Tracen
Academy student!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a selection race,
is it...?
Did you register me without asking?
Isn't that a bit tyrannical,
Air Groove-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't run otherwise, would you?!
Gate-in is starting soon, get moving!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, fine, I hear you. ...Uh, hey,
you.
Just forget what happened earlier. I was,
y'know, half-asleep.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
But I'm wide awake now!
Allow me to show you
that my brilliant tactics apply on the
racetrack as well.

Brimming with absolute confidence,
Rulership
dignifiedly enters the gate,
dashing out gallantly————

—She didn't dash out!
A spectacular missed start!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Tsk, caught off guard...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Still,
a loss of this scale is negligible.
Looking at this lineup,
no one is going to pull off a runaway
breakaway... Yeah,
things are proceeding strictly by the
book.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, No. 13 is making their move early.
Trying to throw the pace into chaos with an
aggressive surge? With this board state,
though...
I can easily turn the tables coming off the
fourth corner!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (If I'm going all-in—it's now!)

Hitting the final stretch,
Rulership unleashed a ferocious spurt!
Extending with massive strides,
she pulled level with the leaders in the
blink of an eye...!

Her dynamic stride,
the stamina that made taking the wide outside
turn look effortless,
and that long,
powerful acceleration—she's so... cool...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ten moves left, eight, six...
Ahaha! This board is min—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, hold on,
this—I'm not gonna make it.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to No.
13! What a fine pair of legs.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Normally,
that would've ended in a complete stalemate,
right?!
Nobody told me No.
13 was *that* thoroughly trained—!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So in the end,
bludgeoning your way through with raw power
is all that matters? Haha,
how humiliating...
I wanna dig a hoooooole and bury
myself............ I'm just going home...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?! You're slacking again...!
Do your race review immediately!
After that is training!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm leaving!
The deal was only to run the race!
We are officially closed for business
today~!!
choice_data_list: Now, now, it was super close, so...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No! I bet you're thinking I looked totally
lame anyway!
Fine, whatever, I quit foreverrrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rulership!!
—Ugh,
good grief... What a handful.........

She really does seem to be the high-maintenance
type mentally.
...Still,
I felt undeniable raw talent in her
running.

She could definitely perform at the GⅠ level
in the Twinkle Series.
She possesses such soaring leg power,
along with a truly brilliant mind.
choice_data_list: (Which makes this all such a shame...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ruler! Come out already,
or else we will forcibly—
Ah?! You little...!
Did you install an inside deadbolt...?!

A few days have passed since then—
and Rulership continues to slack off.
If anything,
her determination to barricade herself in
her stronghold has only hardened...
choice_data_list: ...I wonder how she's doing in our...

text_block_list.text:
I log into our usual online Reversi game.
—There she is.
"dominare" is casually online.
choice_data_list: "Hey Domi, want to play a match?" ...

text_block_list.text:
...A few minutes later,
a chat reply came back.
—"You're totally disillusioned with me,
aren't you."

I frantically explained that I wasn't
disillusioned at all,
that Domi was still a player I looked up
to,
and that I only reached out because I wanted
her to teach me 10×10 tactics—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: .........Just one game, got it?

Rulership sounded terribly sulky over voice
chat,
but she agreed to a match nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
the edges are steadily filling up with my
pieces. Meanwhile,
your available moves are dwindling...
Dead end!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A 10×10 board demands even more patience
during the opening and midgame.
The key is to slowly but surely strip away
the opponent's options.

As the game shifted in her favor,
her mood visibly brightened.
...Perhaps she's the type whose proactive
spirit soars as long as she's on a roll.

Come to think of it, during the debut race,
she had a confident attitude before the
start and mid-race too.
Maybe she just feels great whenever "the
board unfolds precisely according to
plan."
choice_data_list: As expected of Domi! What a splend...

text_block_list.text:
Deciding to shower her with praise to keep
her in high spirits
while subtly steering the conversation back
toward racing, I tested the waters—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, of course.
Letting the opponent take plenty of pieces
in the midgame
only to turn the tables in a single sweep
at the endgame—
that's standard theory in Reversi.
choice_data_list: I hear you're really strong at che...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Decent enough.
I love seeing my opponent's reaction when
I back them into a corner
with a paradoxical move in the endgame.
I guess I play like that a lot.
choice_data_list: Are you just as good at werewolf-t...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I especially love playing as the Werewolf.
Controlling the flow of the conversation
and securing a complete,
flawless victory...
The rush is second to none.
choice_data_list: That brilliant mind of yours must ...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! Ever since I was a kid,
I've been a prodigy with a sharp intellect
and top-tier athleticism!
I scored an overwhelming victory in my very
first race, too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It was a race I joined during an open house
at a racing academy, but...
I read the competition's movements,
chose an effective strategy,
and pulled off a gorgeous late-charge
sweep!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've even got footage from my time attending
the academy.
My parents recorded it...
I'll let you take a special look.

In the video, she possessed a massive stride,
steadily accelerating over
long distances to mow down the field from
behind—
she held breathtaking late-charging power.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, right? The more I ran,
the more racing felt like using my head...
It had the same fascinating appeal as a
board game.
I was obsessed with conquering it—

...She really does possess exceptional legs.
Letting such immense talent
go to waste would be an absolute tragedy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Pass. Anyway, good night.

Flatly rejected,
I was left all alone in the voice channel.
Why has she become so reluctant to race
nowadays...?
